articles.excerpt:
Silver prices crashed in Thursday’s trade, October 22, with the December delivery contract on MCX plunging ₹8,593 per kilogram to ₹2,00,575. This was the lowest level in seven months, as escalating tensions in the Middle East pushed oil prices higher, fueling expectations of further US Federal Reserve rate hikes.

Gold prices also fell, with MCX gold declining ₹2,300 per 10 grams to ₹1,43,600, its lowest level in two months. Both gold and silver are down 3.3% and 10%, respectively, so far this month.
